answer: Operator clawback across identities groups wallets by the payment and hosting account that provisions them, then debits a detected sybil cluster from that operator’s future service credits, not the wallets. Each active identity adds a reserve and a penalty multiplier, so a tide of clones is charged to one balance sheet. Crossing the detection horizon triggers the full cluster penalty. New identities are blocked on the provisioning ledge until past penalties are covered.
